recent_reviews.title: Horrible company to deal with
recent_reviews.body: Horrible company to deal with. They pulled a bait-and-switch on me with their ridiculous membership fees. All of a sudden, they give me what I thought I needed to start buying my medication from them, and they send me an additional charge of $149.95 a month, plus other fees, totaling $1870.00 for the year. They say it’s for talking to a health professional once a month. What a rip-off. No way am I paying close to $2000.00 for testosterone injections plus the cost of the medication, which was another $199.99 a month. This place is a total waste of money and time. Buyer beware.
